observed_positive_delta: PhysicalCohortWitness is intentionally non-serializable and constructor-gated by an in-process mint token.
The capability carries ten pidfds and require_physical_witness checks that those handles remain valid with fstat.
The candidate checks an explicit S1 inode against caller-supplied readonly binding rows and rejects an explicit synthetic_source_fixture_only flag.
The source_fixture_receipt shape is explicitly SOURCE_FIXTURE_ONLY and zero-credit for physical/model/training promotion.
material_counterevidence: mint_barrier_witness itself accepts ready_by_node, readonly_s1_fd_binding, s1_file_identity and required_physical_predicates as ordinary caller-supplied mappings rather than deriving them from the retained observer inside the mint authority boundary.

pidfd_open proves a live process handle can be acquired for the supplied PID; it does not prove that the supplied ready marker, read receipt, barrier timestamps, transaction state or claimed S1 FD rows came from observing that process.

The candidate compares each supplied FD row inode to the supplied s1_file_identity inode, but it does not independently read /proc/<pid>/fdinfo or stat the actual S1 path while minting. A coherent caller-fabricated row set therefore remains semantically possible at source/API level.

The current tests monkeypatch pidfd support, pidfd_open, fstat and close. They establish source structure and nonserialization behavior only; they do not establish an observed procfs-to-S1 causal chain.
No current code-search evidence shows require_physical_witness integrated into the sole retained FusedFabric.atomic_fused_cohort_commit physical mutation boundary.
hypothesis: pidfds are valuable as one non-serializable liveness/process-incarnation component of a physical witness, but only if minting owns the observation operation and derives procfs/S1/barrier evidence directly rather than accepting those facts from caller mappings.
counterhypothesis: The caller mappings can be treated as trusted because the intended caller is the retained spawn_held_cohort observer.
adjudication: Reject the counterhypothesis under fail-closed evidence law until source structure itself constrains minting to the retained observation path. Intent and naming do not prove provenance. pidfd validity alone must not upgrade caller-supplied physical predicates into observed facts.
preferred_fusion: Salvage pidfd handles into the sole retained FusedFabric physical witness path rather than adding a peer facade.
Open pidfds and read exact /proc/<pid>/fdinfo inside the same observation/mint boundary while the barrier is held.
Stat the actual canonical S1 DB path inside that boundary and bind device+inode, not a caller-supplied s1_file_identity mapping.
Bind each pidfd/PID to the exact ready marker, NODE_RESULT producer PID, read-receipt digest, generation/epoch/state digest and observed readonly S1 FD identity before release.
Hash/identify observer source before invocation and verify consumed/unchanged identity after invocation; a post-hoc source hash alone is not consumed-byte attestation.
Require the sole retained physical mutation entry to consume this witness capability; raw proof mappings must fail before envelope validation or state mutation.
Keep an explicit SOURCE_FIXTURE_ONLY entry whose cohort identity and persisted evidence class are disjoint from PHYSICAL_OBSERVED and whose receipts hard-code zero physical credit.
next_exact_action: Fuse only the pidfd liveness/incarnation mechanism into the sole retained observation-bound physical witness path, with procfs and actual S1 device/inode derivation performed inside minting; do not treat caller-supplied FD/predicate mappings as physical evidence and do not merge a peer facade as closure.
